name: SVT-AV1
notes: 2026-11-01: AV1 encoder via FFmpeg libsvtav1 or SvtAv1EncApp. rav1e considered and skipped in its favour.
2026-11-01: No alpha; may be recorded as an FFmpeg capability.
summary: AOMedia software AV1 encoder library, used standalone or through FFmpeg’s libsvtav1 encoder. It produces AV1 elementary streams or containerized output via a host muxer. Its strength is production-oriented speed and quality tuning across offline VOD and real-time modes; output has no alpha channel.
use_when: Encode opaque video to AV1 with explicit speed, quality or latency tradeoffs
Use with FFmpeg when an established transcode and mux pipeline is needed
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg/libx264 or libx265 for broader playback compatibility
Use an alpha-capable codec when transparency must survive encoding

install.macos: brew install svt-av1 (or use FFmpeg built with libsvtav1)

assessment.rationale: SVT-AV1 v4.2.0 is dated 2026-07-14 and the canonical GitLab project shows commits in November 2026. Code is BSD-3-Clause-Clear; AOM Patent License 1.0 is separately relevant. Provides an encoder option beyond FFmpeg’s default codecs.
